mentions.note: the Harry Wright Shield Competition is named after him
the "Harry Wright" Shield, awarded annually to the best field events performer
Printed as '2. H.WRIGHT.' in the key (no 3 visible before the 2); the sequence (31, 33) and the numbered drawing (32 at top left) make him No. 32 in the 1923 photograph
in Blackstaffe & Murphy Shield races group photo, 1914
